generatedFrom: Figma Plugin API — figma.getLocalTextStylesAsync() + variable resolution
note: Snapshot of the 36 text styles imported from packages/engine/out/nb.tokens.json into Figma. Each property records whether it is bound to a Figma variable, which variable, and the resolved value across every mode of that variable's collection. Non-bindable properties (textDecoration, textCase) are always baked. fontStyle is currently baked because the engine has no fontStyle primitive — it is derived from the numeric weight-role at import time.

font.description: Font primitives — font-family (STRING), font-size (FLOAT, 22 steps 10→160px), font-weight (FLOAT, 100→900), font-weight-role (FLOAT, aliased to numeric weight)

font-fluid.description: Fluid font-size primitives — one FLOAT variable per fluid composite; mobile & desktop have distinct values. Bound as fontSize on the 10 fluid text styles.

bakedByDesign.textDecoration: Not variable-bindable in Figma; used to render underlines on *-link variants.
bakedByDesign.textCase: Not variable-bindable in Figma; used to render uppercase on eyebrow.
bakedByDesign.lineHeight: Engine emits an unitless multiplier (e.g. 1.5×); Figma binds line-height as px. Baked per composite (fontSize × multiplier at desktop size).
bakedByDesign.letterSpacing: Engine emits em (e.g. -0.02em); Figma binds letter-spacing as px. Baked per composite (fontSize × em at desktop size).
bakedByDesign.fontStyle: Engine has no fontStyle primitive — the numeric weight-role is the source. The string is derived at import (400→"Regular", 600→"Semi Bold", 700→"Bold", 300→"Light"; JetBrains Mono lacks "Semi Bold", so 600→"Medium"). fontStyle is technically bindable in Figma but is not bound here.

revisions.change: all 8 text/caption/* lineHeight 1.5 -> 1.4 (md 16.5px -> 15.4px at 11px; lg 18px -> 16.8px at 12px)
revisions.why: Caption shared the `normal` rung (1.50) with body, so the smallest running text the system emits carried long-form body leading. #388 adds a `cozy` rung at 1.40 -- the first BODY step on the ladder (KB body range 1.4-1.6) -- and binds caption to it, so caption is tighter than body without dropping into heading leading. This is a DELIBERATE divergence from the NB source: NB ships caption at 1.5, and the engine now emits 1.4 on purpose. PREDICTED, not re-captured: a fresh figma.getLocalTextStylesAsync() import of the regenerated nb.tokens.json would report these values. Every other field in this file remains the original capture.

The engine's display leading was flat `tight` (1.05) across 48-160px while `title` banded by size; display.sm at 48px sat two rungs below title.2xl at 40px. Banding display sends 48px to `snug` (1.15), so 48 x 1.15 = 55.2. PREDICTED, not re-captured: a fresh figma.getLocalTextStylesAsync() import of the regenerated nb.tokens.json would report this value. Every other field in this file remains the original capture.
